description: This is a test script in Lua that performs comprehensive testing of Lua interpreter features, including environment handling, command-line options, script execution, warning mechanisms, error handling, and signal interruption.

methods.name: prepfile
methods.description: Creates or overwrites a temporary file with specified content, supporting binary mode.

methods.name: getoutput
methods.description: Reads content from output temporary file and deletes it, returning the content.

methods.name: checkprogout
methods.description: Checks if the program output matches expected output, line by line.

methods.name: checkout
methods.description: Verifies that the output from running a command matches the expected string.

methods.name: RUN
methods.description: Executes a command with formatted arguments, asserting successful execution.

methods.name: NoRun
methods.description: Executes a command expecting failure, checks for specific error messages in output.
